part.text: The robot is standing and the corridor runs straight ahead. I'll walk forward and check the camera as I go.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The wall ahead is about 1.7 m away and I don't see the green panel yet. I'll look around to check the sides.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The panorama shows no green panel yet. The corridor seems to continue ahead, with an opening toward the front-left. I'll move forward a short distance and check again.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: A wall is now 0.77 m ahead and there's still no green panel in view. I'll sweep the head to find the open route.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The green panel is visible to the left, down a side passage. I'll turn left toward it and check the distance.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The green panel is now straight ahead. I'll walk toward it and check the distance.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel is closer now but not yet at the wall. I'll advance a bit more.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel is now off to the left and close. I'll turn left to face it squarely.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: I've turned and now face a wall about 0.7 m away, not the panel. I'll sweep the head to re-locate the green panel.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The green panel is now to the right. I'll turn toward it and advance.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel is close on my right. I'll make a short turn toward it and check again.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The green panel now fills the view directly ahead, so I'm in front of it. Resting the robot.

state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot is resting in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor, in a crouched position with its motors off.

The route was longer than a straight corridor: it went forward about 4 m, then through a side passage on the left and a turn right, to reach the panel. I stopped when the panel filled the camera view directly ahead. I didn't measure the final gap exactly, since the side sonar reads about 0.78 m. Ahead, the panel looks close, roughly half a metre, so the robot is in front of it but not touching it.
